description: Look up a domain's MX records with priorities and resolved IPs, and identify the mailbox provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Zoho, Fastmail and others) and any security gateway in front of it (Mimecast, Proofpoint, Barracuda and others). Pass `domains` instead of `domain` for up to 100 at once, which also returns a provider breakdown. Reports a null MX (RFC 7505) rather than treating it as a broken record, and does not guess the provider behind a gateway, because that is not observable from the MX.

domain.description: A single domain, e.g. "acme.com". An address like "a@acme.com" is accepted.

name: lookup_mx
title: MX records and mail provider
